Between what times could Andrew have gone to the clothing store?

Options:
(A) 9am to 11am
(B) 6pm to 9pm
(C) 11am to 5pm
(D) 5pm to 6pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
cot:

However, since the clothing store was closed after 9pm, Andrew could not have gone there between 5pm and 9pm. The only remaining option is between 11am and 5pm, but since Andrew was at the train station from 11am to 5pm, he couldn't have gone to the clothing store during this time either.

The only time slot that fits the criteria is between 6pm and 9pm, as this is the only period when Andrew was not engaged in any of the activities mentioned and the store was open.
